top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig solved a distinct mechanistic problem from the 2010 C-C coupling prize (amine binding, deprotonation and hard C-N reductive elimination from Pd-amido complexes) through ligand design, giving a general method with over 25 years of independent confirmation and an exact two-name allocation. P003 follows because its bifunctional-degrader citation matches its three names better than P004, which blends PROTAC and cereblon-glue strands; P002 is the youngest and least settled, but a real achievement, so it ranks above no award.
